scope: Weighted sampled stacks from raw V8 CPU profiles. timeDeltas are sample weights, not hardware CPU accounting or benchmark elapsed estimates. Debugger pauses, startup marker waits and hooks perturb these diagnostic launches. No outliers or long sample deltas are removed.
coverage: Named IPC attribution is an explicit function-name heuristic, with raw URL/line/column identities retained. Missing recognizable frames do not imply zero IPC work. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed. Hook-named self weight is literal attribution, not an overhead correction: V8 may charge native postMessage work to its JS wrapper when native frames are not exposed. All such weight is retained; never subtract it as instrumentation overhead.
